nodes.author: MuyundaSimenda
nodes.text: China is back again on the global scene. Five years ago it was COVID-19, now it seem to be part two of COVID-19, a mysterious virus called Human metapneumovirus (HMPV). The only thing AfriKa should do with our weak systems is to tighten disease surveillance.
